It is an online portal of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, which has made all the information related to the company available to various stakeholders and it has been made accessible to the general public. It was started from the year 2006. It was amended by Company Act, 1956 and New Company Act, 2013. And is designed to completely automate all processes related to proactive enforcement and compliance with legal requirements under the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008.
